description: KL333: sizes kiln.surfaces refuses, in a surfaces section, inline and on a retexture; a greyscale normal map, a data map in colour, sRGB and linear tags, 16 bits. A missing file is KL501, a file that is not a PNG KL503. A good surface says nothing.

diagnostics.message: tex/odd.png: 6x8 is not a power of two on both sides (kiln.surfaces refuses this surface, and the material looks like Rough Stone)
tex/rough_colour.png is in colour: a roughness map's red channel is read and the rest is ignored; save it as greyscale
tex/normal_grey.png is greyscale: a normal map's red and green are its direction, so this one is flat
tex/height_srgb.png is tagged sRGB; a height map's values are read as they are, as linear data
tex/ao_16.png has 16 bits a channel: it is read at 8
tex/albedo_linear.png is tagged linear, but an albedo map is read as sRGB colour: it will look brighter than in your editor
tex/not_really.png is not a PNG file (kiln.assets decodes PNG only)
tex/tiny.png: 2x2 is outside 4..4096 (kiln.surfaces refuses this surface, and the material looks like Rough Stone)
tex/odd.png: 6x8 is not a power of two on both sides (kiln.surfaces refuses this surface, and the material looks like Rough Stone)
